name: @crm/companies-service
description: Owns company profile data (companies_schema: companies, company_status_history, processed_events, outbox_events). Serves POST /companies, GET /companies/public, GET /companies/me, GET /companies/:companyId, PATCH /companies/:companyId, GET /companies/:companyId/status-history. See docs/architecture/microservices-extraction-checklist.md Phase 4.
